column3: You have to help me! My boys are lost in the ventilation system!
I could direct them back with my horn, but I'd need some sort of mouthpiece!
Doesn't that thing go in your ear?
Hurry! My boys have no sense of direction!
Have you repaired my horn yet?
Oi you! What's going on in there?
There was a mishap with the ventilation system, but it's all fine now!
Now, if you'll excuse me...
What a wonderful coat. You know, my sister had one just like it!
Oh my! It sounds like she had exquisite taste.
Indeed.
Mr Liu?
I suspect the Rosebud could put an elephant to sleep.
I shouldn't inflict further torment upon the man, unless absolutely necessary.
May I get you something to drink?
No, that won't be necessary.
Then perhaps I can interest you in some appetisers, while you decide?
No, I'm not interested in mediocrity.
A main dish, then? Our soup of the day comes highly recommended.
Soup? Do I look like someone who would be caught dead ordering soup?
That's just idiotic, if you'll forgive me for saying so.
These dishes are so mundane. Uninspired, don't you think?
Do you have anything that actually requires skill and creativity to prepare?
If you'll allow me to check with the kitchen, I'll see if they can prepare something to your liking?
Yes, always.
Yes? What is it you want?
Are you waiting for someone?
What does it look like I'm doing, detective?
Loitering?
I'm waiting on the shoe shine girl.
Shoe shine girl?
Oui, I need to look my best for Lady Unterwald this evening.
Alas, that girl is far too preoccupied with her toys right now.
The shoe shine girl is too preoccupied with her toy set?
Do you currently observe my shoes being shined?
Then you have your answer, detective!
How could a paying customer possibly compete with the Dirk Chiselton Deducing Kit?
What's this about a Dirk Chiselton Deducing Kit?
All I know is it's currently preventing me from getting my shoes polished.
Blast! My publishers assured me the Dirk line was still in the prototyping phase.
Oui, I was waiting for the shoe shine girl to finish her break.
Since you gave her that manuscript, she hasn't looked up once!
Still waiting to get those shoes shined?
Oh, I'm still waiting, monsieur.
Something tells me you're some sort of artist.
Tell me, what gave it away?
The assorted paints and paintbrushes?
My paint stained overalls?
It was the beret, wasn't it?
Ah, I'm afraid a detective never reveals their secrets.
That's magicians, isn't it?
It can be two things!
How's business in the art world?
Lady Unterwald has been kind enough to provide me with a steady stream of work.
As it happens, I'm preparing to capture her portrait this very evening!
You're on the Unterwald payroll?
I wish! Every artist would jump at the chance for a steady paycheque!
Alas, our agreement is more... commissions based.
Do you have a preferred artistic medium?
I prefer the canvas, but these hands have also sculpted many things.
If you take the time to look around, you'll find many of my pieces aboard this train.
Of course, I'm not always at liberty to discuss them.
Are you enjoying the band?
You know, they painstakingly arrange their songs for their live shows?
That's certainly intriguing.
No, that kind of dedication to the performance?
It's art!
What happened to Balboa Swing?
I've never seen them walk off the stage during a set before.
Balboa Swing strives for perfection, something must have thrown them off.
I have to go now.
I'm afraid the whereabouts of this idol eludes me; I don't recall seeing it before.
You should know I think this whole thing is completely absurd, if that's any consolation.
Not particularly.
Good news, I located that hand idol you were looking for!
You have? Then we might finally get our meeting underway!
What's going on with you and Lady Unterwald?
It is my intention to take ownership of the Unterwald empire.
I believe this is in everyone's interest, including Lady Unterwald.
How would selling the business benefit Lady Unterwald?
It's my understanding that the Unterwald empire is suffering from financial difficulties.
I'll reveal more once our meeting begins, but I'd be more than willing to take it off her hands.
So, it's purely all business with you and Lady Unterwald?
Well-I... I-
I assure you, that's none of your concern.
Am I to understand you're a member of the Order of Idle Hands?
It's true, I was once an active member of the order.
I thought we were doing necessary work, but it soon devolved into secret handshakes, and petty rituals.
Eventually, all this bureaucracy seemed to prevent anything from being achieved.
I assume the bureaucracy hasn't improved?
No, it's worse.
That's all I need to know right now!
Sure.
You know, my memory of that evening is a little hazy!
That's probably to be expected, you all took quite the beating.
Is that why my arm is in a cast?
It's okay, let's just start small.
Don't you think I should speak to an attorney?
You hear that, Bailey? The man wants to speak to an attorney!
Brave man, especially after all the legal trouble Mr Ackerman has landed you in.
Hmm. I suppose it couldn't hurt to regale you with a new Herman tale.
Atta boy!
And I'd have complete immunity, right?
What would you need immunity from?
There may have been some collateral damage during my endeavours.
I'm sure we could come to some sort of arrangement.
So long as you start talking.
Anything for an adoring fan!
I knew we could count on you!
I noticed you were having trouble ordering.
And if I was? Forgive me, but that's none of your business.
Do you consider yourself a curator of sustenance?
Well, I-I
Ah, spare me your stuttering!
Tell me, for how long am I to endure your incessant hovering?
Perhaps you'd care for a drink while you wait?
What is this? Are you employed here, or are you just another busybody?
No, I'll have a drink with my meal.
What brings you aboard the Reuss Express?
Business, although it's all been for naught.
A gentleman's agreement used to mean something, you know!
Your business was cancelled?
Let's just say there was a disagreement between parties.
We agreed on a price, and the other party chose to renege on the deal.
Amateurs, I'm surrounded by amateurs!
Are you familiar with the Unterwald family?
Yes, I'm familiar with them. They're not my cup of tea.
I heard the family has run the Unterwald empire into the ground, and now they're looking for a quick way out.
Lady Unterwald must have gone senile in recent years, entrusting those fools with even a modicum of power!
Don't even get me started on those nephews of hers. Awful! Just deeply dumb.
You're not a fan of the Unterwalds, but you ride the Reuss Express?
You seem to be confusing business with pleasure.
This is purely a means to an end for me.
Even so, a man has to eat, does he not?
Indeed, that would be for the best.
I'm afraid you have something that I need.
And what is it that you think I have?
I don't know what it is, but I think you know...
Do you know how ridiculous that sounds?
Yes, I hear it now.
The item you possess, it belongs to Donny Donato.
Ah, and that coward sent you to do his bidding?
Are you supposed to be his muscle? You're practically skin and bones!
I'm merely an interested party.
I'm sorry to say I've named my price, and you won't convince me otherwise.
If it's a question of price, I'm willing to negotiate!
Trust me, it's more than you could afford.
Don't waste our time.
Are you an acquaintance of Donny Donato?
Don't bore me by talking about that man, he sets my teeth on edge.
What's your history with Donny?
He's an arrogant bully, that's what. A selfish, self-serving sleazeball!
I see. It would be fair to say there's some bad blood between you?
I don't know what he's promised you, but you should never trust a gangster.
No, I've already left my fate in that waiter's hands.
Who knows what foul concoction awaits me in that kitchen.
I suppose I have no choice. Begone!
I apologise, sir, but the kitchen is closed due to an incident.
I suppose it was too much to ask for a meal with a hint of imagination?
Would you care to order a drink instead?
Name?
Jian Liu.
Please go right ahead, Mr Liu.
Did they stop talking? I can't hear them!
Why are you so heavy?
I can't hear what's going on with you two yapping!
I'm not sure I can hold on much longer!
What are they saying, mummy?
I'm slipping!
Steady yourselves!
You're gonna drop me!
Steady!
I don't believe we've had the privilege?
Lady Arista Gudrun, a pleasure to meet you.
And these are my boys...
Hagen Gudrun, a pleasure to meet you!
That's not right, you blithering idiot.
It's not?
You're Gunter, and he's Hagen!
Since when?!
I can't believe you'd steal my name, you fish-eyed freak!
Spineless weasel!
Bootless haggard!
Tottering codpiece!
Oh, now you've gone and done it! I've broken the mouthpiece.
I'm confused, who are you again?
Gunter Gudrun, Underground Operational Executive.
Hagen Gudrun, Overground Operational Executive.
Why does his title get to be longer?
Quiet!
